newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Banco de Credito Argentino 9-mth net $31.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Credito Argentino 9-mth net $31.6 mln.

text.p: Banco de Credito Argentino Thursday said that in the first nine months to March 31 it posted a net gain of $31.6 million versus $13.49 million in the same period of fiscal year 1996.
The bank provided no comparatives in its report to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange, but a bank official told Reuters that in the corresponding period year ago it posted a $13.49 million gain.
It added at March 31 its net worth stood at $305 million resulting from total assets of $3.58 billion and total liabilities of $3.27 billion.
In March it posted a net gain of $3.58 million.
Credito, one of Argentina's top 10 retail banks, Friday signed a deal to sell 71.8 percent of its shares to also local Banco Frances for $466 million.
Frances is controlled by Spain's Banco de Bilbao Vizcaya .
